comment: The redirect URL is hardcoded here. It would be better to centralize this logic to ensure consistency with other parts of the app (like `signOutAction` in `app/actions/auth.ts`).

While using CSS variables in inline styles works, since Tailwind v4 is used and theme variables are defined in `globals.css`, consider using Tailwind utility classes (e.g., `bg-surface` or `border-border`) instead for consistency with other parts of the project.
Consider moving `HIDDEN_PREFIXES` to a shared configuration file or using a more robust route matching if the list grows or if more complex conditions are needed.
